title: NJ State Ethics Commission — Irene Kropp — Decision — Dismissal (No. 009-14)
text:
OF STATE ETHICS COMMISSION
IN THE MATTER
IRENE KROPP,
FORMER DEPUTY COMMISSIONER,
OF
DEPARTMENT
ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION Commission Case No. 09-14
DECISION
This matter arises from an allegation that Irene Kropp, former Deputy Commissioner
with the Department of Environmental Protection ("DEP"), violated the Conflcts of Interest
Law by failing to recuse from a DEP matter involving the Fenimore Landfill and Strategic
Environmental Parners, LLC.
After considering the results of an investigation into the allegations against Irene Kropp,
the Commission dismissed the matter pursuant to NJA.C. 19:61-3.1(g).
DECISION RENDERED BY THE
STATE ETHICS COMMISSION ON
THE 16th DAY OF SEPTEMBER, 2014
